name: Sparkle ☆Decor
source:
Stuck in lockdown with nothing to do and boredom  clawing at you, you download an isometric dress-up game called SPARKLE☆Decor.  As you're transported into this colorful world, you meet a stranger.  Soon, countless chats blossom into friendship...and possibly  more?

[From [url=https://otojang.itch.io/sparkle-decor-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
由于陷入封锁，无所事事，无聊，你下载了一款名为SPARKLE☆Decor的等距装扮游戏。当你进入这个多彩的世界时，你遇到了一个陌生人。很快，无数的聊天变成了友谊……甚至可能更多？

[来自[url=https://otojang.itch.io/sparkle-decor-demo]itch.io[/url]]
